title: II. József, a kalapos király és rendeletei (Joseph II's Controversial Rule)
grammar: Postpositions of Instrumentality (által, révén) and Enlightened Reforms

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain why Joseph II was called the hatted king.
I can use annak ellenére, hogy and noha to show a contrast.
I can name Joseph II's Edict of Tolerance and his language decree.
I can use eight new words about Joseph II's rule.
